name: Ital Eis Pra
kurzbeschreibung:
**Discover Ice Magic in Imst**

Experience the thrilling world of ice in the heart of **Tirol**! In **Imst**, you can indulge in a unique adventure at **Ital Eis**, where the art of ice carving comes to life.

From intricate sculptures to refreshing ice treats, **Ital Eis** offers a cool escape in the summer months. Whether you're a family looking for fun or a visitor seeking a taste of local tradition, this icy paradise promises unforgettable moments.

Don’t miss the chance to savor traditional **Tiroler** ice creams and enjoy the crisp, refreshing atmosphere of **Imst**!
